snowbird.note: Resort Update: Uphill travel is CLOSED for winter 2026/27 preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations November 27. If you like peace and quiet, now is the best time to visit Snowbird. Though Summer Activities and the Scenic Tram are closed for the season, the hiking and biking trails remain open, and the views are always serving. The Scenic Tram is scheduled to reopen in winter. Speaking of winter, save the date. Opening Day is scheduled for November 27, conditions dependent. Season Passholders, don't forget to use your FREE night at The Cliff Lodge, valid until December 17. The Blister Summit is returning to Snowbird April 6-10. If you love gear, this event is for you. Test next year's skis, boards and outerwear, hear from the best in the biz, and attend evening events including panels and après. Register by October 31 to lock in the best price. Still want some mountain time? The Cliff Spa is open, so you can treat yourself to a relaxing massage before taking a dip in the rooftop pool. Many of Snowbird's restaurants are also operating throughout the week. Enjoy a decadent steak at the Steak Pit or enjoy the view from the 10th floor of The Cliff Lodge at The Aerie . Can't wait to see you up here!
